declarations.name: Poincare.ParabolicGraphSupport.derivatives_zero_off_closed
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (E : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
(α T : ℝ) (G : Poincare.ParabolicSolutionGraph.Graph (E := E) α T)
(K : Set E), IsClosed K → 0 < T →
(∀ s ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, ∀ y : E, y ∉ K → G.u (s,y) = 0) →
∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), x ∉ K →
 G.ut (t,x) = 0 ∧ G.du (t,x) = 0 ∧ G.ddu (t,x) = 0
